name: arsim-tds-qe-ghcp-interface
description: Enterprise QE workflow interface for GitHub Copilot Chat models inside VS Code: PR Analysis, PROD Incident Analysis, with managed Skills, Instructions and Custom Prompts sourced from .github/.

arsimTdsQe.maxContextCharsPerFile.description: Maximum characters read from a single selected skill/instruction/prompt file when it is included in the LLM context. Does NOT apply to an attached file -- see arsimTdsQe.maxAttachedFileContextChars.

arsimTdsQe.maxAttachedFileContextChars.description: Hard ceiling (in characters) on an attached file's content included in the LLM context. Kept separate from arsimTdsQe.maxContextCharsPerFile, which is sized for short Skill/Instruction files, not full documents. In practice this is usually NOT the binding limit: the effective budget scales down to the selected model's real context window (maxInputTokens) automatically, recomputed before every request -- this setting only matters as an upper ceiling if the model's window is very large.

arsimTdsQe.maxTotalContextChars.description: Hard ceiling (in characters) on total combined context (skills + instructions + prompt + attached file + user text) sent to the model in a single request. Like maxAttachedFileContextChars, the effective budget scales down automatically to the selected model's real context window when known -- this setting is the upper bound for models with very large windows, or the fallback when a model doesn't report its window size.

arsimTdsQe.defaultWorkflow.description: Workflow id selected by default when the panel first opens. 'generic' shows as '-- Select --' and sends requests with no workflow-specific instructions.

arsimTdsQe.maxTokenHistoryEntries.description: Maximum number of token-usage history entries retained locally. Oldest entries are dropped beyond this limit.

arsimTdsQe.maxAttachFileSizeMB.description: Maximum size (MB) of a file that can be attached via Browse for .docx/.pdf/.csv/.xlsx/.xls/text files. Parsing fully loads the file into memory as JS objects/strings, which for CSV/XLSX in particular can use significantly more memory than the file's on-disk size -- lower this on memory-constrained machines if large attachments cause the extension host to struggle.

arsimTdsQe.serviceNowInstanceUrl.description: Base URL of the ServiceNow instance queried by the PROD Incident Analysis workflow.

arsimTdsQe.serviceNowUsername.description: Basic-auth username for the ServiceNow incident API used by PROD Incident Analysis. Not secret. The matching password is never stored here -- it's entered once via a masked prompt and held in VS Code's encrypted SecretStorage; use "ARSIM TDS QE: Forget ServiceNow Password" (Command Palette) to clear it, e.g. after a rotation.

arsimTdsQe.serviceNowApiTimeoutMs.description: Timeout (ms) for a ServiceNow incident-fetch request before it's treated as failed.

arsimTdsQe.jiraApiTimeoutMs.description: Timeout (ms) for a Jira ticket/attachment fetch request (Generate Feature File From Jira Story) before it's treated as failed.

arsimTdsQe.confluenceMaxDepth.description: Sub-page recursion depth for importing a Confluence page tree into a Knowledge Base (the root page counts as depth 0). Leave as null to use the depth compiled into this build; set a number to override it.

arsimTdsQe.confluenceMaxPages.description: Hard cap on the number of Confluence pages a single import will fetch, so a link into a very large space can't spawn an unbounded number of requests. The import reports if it stopped early because of this cap.

arsimTdsQe.confluenceApiTimeoutMs.description: Timeout (ms) for a single Confluence API request (page, child list, or attachment download) before it's treated as failed.

arsimTdsQe.ragTopK.description: Knowledge Base retrieval (RAG): how many of the most relevant chunks to retrieve and add to the request's context. Higher values give the model more to work with but consume more of the context budget -- watch the Context Limit meter.

arsimTdsQe.ragChunkChars.description: Knowledge Base retrieval (RAG): target size in characters of each indexed chunk. Documents are split on paragraph boundaries, so actual chunk sizes vary around this target. Smaller chunks retrieve more precisely; larger chunks preserve more surrounding context per hit. Changing this rebuilds every index.

arsimTdsQe.ragChunkOverlapChars.description: Knowledge Base retrieval (RAG): how many characters of the previous chunk to repeat at the start of the next one. Overlap keeps a fact that straddles a chunk boundary retrievable from either side. Set to 0 to disable. Changing this rebuilds every index.

arsimTdsQe.bm25K1.description: BM25 term-frequency saturation parameter (k1). Controls how quickly repeated occurrences of a query term stop increasing a chunk's score. Typical range 1.2-2.0; lower values saturate sooner. Leave at the default unless you are deliberately tuning retrieval.

arsimTdsQe.bm25B.description: BM25 document-length normalization parameter (b). 0 disables length normalization entirely; 1 applies it fully, penalizing long chunks the most. Leave at the default unless you are deliberately tuning retrieval.

scripts.package: npm run compile && node -e "require('fs').mkdirSync('dist-vsix',{recursive:true})" && vsce package --out ./dist-vsix/ --allow-missing-repository
